QA-29129 is a **PASS**, with one caveat: the Reach assertion (A5) is only trivially met. The report is at `results/2026-10-29/QA-29129-report.md`.

I ran it on the UCLA account (default brand, University of California, Los Angeles) with the Impressions data set, LinkedIn only, Last 30 Days (Sep 28 – Oct 27). All 129 posts were scraped from the Table View.

- **Impressions:** Organic + Paid = Impressions on 129/129 posts. Paid Impressions is "–" on every post, so Organic equals Impressions.
- **Reach:** Reach, Organic Reach and Paid Reach are all "–" on every post, so the identity holds only as no data equals no data. The earlier runs of this case gave the same result.
- **Engagement Rate:** Engagements / Impressions matches the displayed rate on 129/129 posts.
- **Engaged User Rate:** shows "–" on 129/129 posts.
- **Known bugs:** none open on the case, and none reproduced.

My login script embedded the password, and the Playwright tool echoed it into the transcript. I deleted the script file afterwards. If the transcript is retained, consider rotating the `lfiqa` password.

I did not touch the skill or REGISTRY, since that is deferred to harvest. The report's harvest notes flag that the Table View headers have no spaces and need whitespace stripped before keying rows.
